mara: quick heads-up: hit a flaky bug in sampleapp rerank. JS SDK retry after 401 sometimes produces embeddings length 1025 vs expected 1024, causing rerank error.
jin: 1025? sounds like padding/off-by-one. any repro pattern?
mara: flaky, ~1/6k batches. looks linked to retry path rebuilding payload; one vector ends up with an extra 0.0 at the end.
sam: can you paste the captured payload (redacted)?
mara: captured body (redacted): { "model": "embed-lite-1", "inputs": [[0.12,0.03,...,0.0]], /* observed len 1025 */ }
lina: our Python helper explicitly slices/pads to dim. JS uses TypedArray/Buffer paths in retry flow; maybe Buffer.concat adds an extra byte that becomes 0.0 float.
mara: also the rerank helper zips inputs->embeddings by index assuming lengths match, so it explodes when mismatch happens.
jin: two fixes: (A) add client-side dim validation guard; (B) include embedding_dim in server response envelope so clients can validate.
sam: short-term: add pre-send assert in sampleapp to bail on wrong dims. also add idempotency-key header to avoid duplicate processing during retries.
mara: added local guard and CLI debug `ri embed-inspect --show-lengths`. prevents crash but doesn't fix root cause.
lina: I'll add an assertion in the JS SDK batcher to throw on unexpected dims and an opt-in auto-trim option. also starting an RFC to add `embedding_dim` to response envelope.
jin: add a unit test in JS SDK simulating auth-fail+retry to assert lengths preserved, put in CI.
sam: creating infra trace to collect pre/post retry payloads at proxy for diffs. deploy-bot: start trace sampleapp/embed-dim-repro
deploy-bot: trace started id t-2801234567-repro
mara: created ticket DEVEX-1191 and branch `mara/embed-retry-dim-guard`. I'll open PR with tests.
lina: starting branch `lina/js-embed-dim-guard`.
sam: assigning infra traces to rerank owners.
mara: plan: (1) client guard + test, (2) JS SDK assert + opt-in trim, (3) sampleapp README idempotency guidance, (4) infra trace diff and server envelope RFC. will post PR links in #devex. thanks all :thumbsup:
